author: yihao
title: 固件主线合入协议 v6、按键计时、声音和赛车核心
body: 协议 v6（开机打招呼、大厅、投票选模式、准备、暂停、再来一局、掉线和版本错误）已经和按键中断计时（精确到 1 ms）、声音调度、赛车核心整合到一起，格挡按按下的精确时刻判定，按住菜单键 1 秒暂停。全部主机测试和丢包模拟（0% / 30% / 60%）通过，两块板都能编译；编译时加 UI_V5_ONLY 仍是 v5，T0 先上真屏不受影响。都还没上板实测。

en.title: Firmware main line now has protocol v6, button timing, sound and the racing core
en.body: Protocol v6 (hello at boot, lobby, voting on a mode, ready, pause, rematch, link loss and version errors) is integrated with interrupt-timed buttons (to 1 ms), the sound scheduler and the racing core; blocks are judged at the exact press time and holding MENU for 1 s pauses. All host tests and the lossy-radio runs (0% / 30% / 60%) pass and both boards build; building with UI_V5_ONLY keeps v5 so T0 on the real screen is unaffected. Nothing has run on a board yet.

author: yihao
title: 距离传感器定了两个用途：挥手擦浪花、手托升降门
body: 赛车里被潮影的浪花挡住视线时，在掌机上方挥手，每挥一次少挡 0.5 秒；冒险里一个人把手悬在掌机上方托住升降门，队友趁机过去（手的高度换算成和压力垫一样的托力，两者取大的，中央板规则和无线消息都不用改）。规格写在 docs/ui-design.md §5.11、§6.11；传感器建议 VL53L4CD，每台 1 个加 1 个备用。

en.title: Two uses for the distance sensor: wave to wipe the splash, hold up the gate by hand
en.body: In racing, when Tide's splash blocks your view, each wave over the handheld cuts 0.5 s off it; in adventure, one player hovers a hand above the handheld to hold up the gate while the other gets through (the hand height becomes the same 0–100 hold value as the pressure pad, whichever is stronger, so the central rules and radio messages stay the same). Spec in docs/ui-design.md §5.11 and §6.11; suggested sensor VL53L4CD, 1 per handheld plus 1 spare.

author: yihao
title: 传感器计划：三只宠物三种攻击测试；网站按传感器 / 执行器分组
body: 草案：焰灵捏压力垫跟光带（现在的测试）、潮影倾斜掌机用板载加速度计、叶芽跟着板载喇叭的拍子按 A。另外计划加一个 VL53L4CD 距离传感器（串在摇杆的 Qwiic 线上，不占引脚），用途待定（候选：冒险里托起升降门、挥手放技能）。系统架构的硬件视图现在按传感器（输入）和执行器（输出）分组，计划中的部件是虚线框；采购清单和引脚表也同步更新了。

en.title: Sensor plan: three attack trials for three pets; the site groups sensors and actuators
en.body: Draft: Ember squeezes the pressure pad to follow the band (today's trial), Tide tilts the handheld using the on-board accelerometer, Sprout presses A on the beat from the on-board speaker. A VL53L4CD distance sensor is also planned (chained on the joystick's Qwiic cable, no pins), use still open (candidates: holding up a gate in adventure, waving to cast the skill). The hardware architecture view now groups sensors (input) and actuators (output), with planned parts dashed; the parts list and pin table are updated too.

author: yihao
title: 掌机模拟器第二版上线：三种模式都能玩
body: 开机、登录（名字、头像、颜色）、两人投票选模式、大厅、暂停、掉线重连、设置、压力垫校准和结算都做好了。对抗按真规则来；双人赛车里每只宠物有自己的车和手感（焰灵快但升温快、潮影水洼不打滑、叶芽转弯灵），车上坐着小精灵；双人冒险有 4 个房间和石像守卫 Boss。中英文都有，手机上也能玩。

en.title: Handheld simulator v2 is live: all three modes are playable
en.body: Boot, login (name, avatar, colour), voting on a mode, lobbies, pause, reconnect, settings, pad calibration and results are all in. Battle follows the real rules; in two-player racing each pet has its own kart and handling (Ember is fastest but heats up, Tide never skids in puddles, Sprout turns sharpest) with the pet riding on top; co-op adventure has 4 rooms and the Stone Warden boss. Chinese and English, and it works on phones.

author: yihao
title: 网站加入英文界面
body: 右上角的「EN / 中文」按钮可以切换语言，选择会记住；第一次打开时按浏览器语言自动选择。所有页面、对战原型、留言板和数据（任务、零件、引脚、进展）都有英文；留言表单改成中英双语。对战原型的规则说明也精简成了 6 条短句。

en.title: English interface for the site
en.body: The EN / 中文 button at the top switches the language and remembers the choice; the first visit follows the browser language. Every tab, the battle prototype, the guestbook and the data (tasks, parts, pins, updates) are in English, and the review form is bilingual. The battle rules are now 6 short lines.

author: yihao
title: 攻击测试分三层逐层加速；最高一档改为「全力一击」并加伤害上限
body: 光带对人太快，改成三层：第 1 层 35% 速度、第 2 层 65%、第 3 层原速，每层 1.5 秒，总分 = 三层合计在光带内的比例，结束时显示每层成绩。最高一档从「必杀一击」改叫「全力一击」，一次攻击最多 30 点（半管血），不会一击秒杀。固件、终端版和网页原型规则一致。

en.title: Attack trial now has three stages that speed up; the top tier is renamed “Full Power strike” and damage is capped
en.body: The band was too fast for people, so the trial now has three stages: stage 1 at 35% speed, stage 2 at 65% and stage 3 at full speed, 1.5 s each. The score is the share of time the pointer spends inside the band over all three stages, and each stage's result is shown at the end. The top tier is renamed from “Finishing strike” to “Full Power strike”, and one attack deals at most 30 damage (half an HP bar), so nothing is a one-hit KO. The firmware, the terminal version and the web prototype follow the same rules.

author: yihao
title: 新玩法：追踪光带攻击测试 + 连续格挡
body: 攻击方不再按住蓄力，而是做 2 秒的追踪测试：用压力垫（或按住 A）让指针跟住移动的光带，在带内的比例就是分数。<50 普通一击（防守格挡 1 次），50–79 强力一击（2 次，更快更窄），≥80 必杀一击（3 次）。每次格挡挡住对应那一份伤害。固件（协议 v5）、终端版和网页原型规则完全一致，规格见代码仓库 docs/attack-trial.md。还没上板实测；必杀可能偏容易，欢迎在「玩法原型」里调参数。

en.title: New gameplay: band-tracking attack trial + chained blocks
en.body: The attacker no longer holds a button to charge. Instead they take a 2-second tracking trial: use the pressure pad (or hold A) to keep the pointer on the moving band, and the share of time inside the band is the score. Below 50 is a Normal strike (the defender blocks once), 50–79 a Strong strike (2 blocks, faster and narrower), 80 and up a Finishing strike (3 blocks). Each block stops its own share of the damage. The firmware (protocol v5), the terminal version and the web prototype follow exactly the same rules; the spec is docs/attack-trial.md in the code repository. Not yet tested on the boards; the Finishing strike may be a bit too easy, so feel free to tune the parameters in the “Battle prototype” tab.

author: yihao
title: 代码模块化；新增中途换宠物、摇杆选宠物、压力垫蓄力、终端版游戏
body: 固件拆成独立模块（rules / skills / pets / game / controls / player_core），改一处不影响别处，见代码仓库 docs/modules.md。新玩法：进攻方可以花一回合换宠物（网页原型的 F / ; 键）。摇杆左右选宠物，捏压力垫蓄力（没有传感器时仍按住 A）。新增约 2400 项单元测试，修了完美格挡判定偏一格的 bug；回合改成两人各出手一次算一回合。software/test 里 make play 可以在电脑终端里两人对打真实的固件逻辑。都还没上板实测。

en.title: Modular code; new: switching pets mid-battle, picking pets with the joystick, pressure-pad charging, a terminal version of the game
en.body: The firmware is split into independent modules (rules / skills / pets / game / controls / player_core), so a change in one place doesn't affect the others; see docs/modules.md in the code repository. New gameplay: the attacker can spend their turn to switch pets (the F / ; keys in the web prototype). Move the joystick left/right to pick a pet and squeeze the pressure pad to charge (without the sensor, hold A as before). Added about 2,400 unit tests and fixed an off-by-one bug in the Perfect block check; a round now means each player acting once. Running make play in software/test lets two people battle on the real firmware logic in a computer terminal. None of this has been tested on the boards yet.

author: yihao
title: 输入 driver、无线测试固件、网页原型改成 3 宠物规则
body: 玩家板加了 Qwiic 摇杆、外接按钮、压力传感器的 driver（全部可选，光板子也能玩）；新的 radio_test 固件每秒报告丢包、延迟和 RSSI，配一份上板测试清单 docs/hardware-test.md。网页玩法原型改成和固件一样的规则：每人 3 只宠物、暗选出场、火克草克水克火，导出的 #define 可以直接替换 game_config.h。都还没上板实测。

en.title: Input drivers, radio test firmware, and the web prototype switched to the 3-pet rules
en.body: The player board now has drivers for the Qwiic joystick, external buttons and the pressure sensor (all optional, so a bare board is still playable). The new radio_test firmware reports packet loss, latency and RSSI every second, with a hardware test checklist in docs/hardware-test.md. The web gameplay prototype now uses the same rules as the firmware: 3 pets per player, a secret pick of who to send out, fire beats grass beats water beats fire, and the exported #defines can directly replace game_config.h. None of this has been tested on the boards yet.

author: yihao
title: 新增留言板
body: 网站多了「留言」页：可以打分、选最喜欢的宠物、写评价，也可以回复别人的评价。留言存在本仓库的 GitHub Issues 里，有 GitHub 账号就能发。

en.title: New guestbook
en.body: The site has a new “Guestbook” tab: give a rating, pick your favorite pet and write a review, or reply to other people's reviews. Entries are stored in this repository's GitHub Issues, so anyone with a GitHub account can post.

author: yihao
title: 定下互联方案：中央板做中转，加入派出宠物对战
body: 三块板用 star topology，中央板保存唯一的 game state 并每 100 ms 广播完整快照；玩家板的每个操作带 step_id，重发直到收到 ACK。蓄力和格挡时机在玩家板本地计时，不受无线延迟影响。每人 3 只宠物（火 / 水 / 草，属性相克），暗中同时选择出场。电脑上的模拟器在 60% 丢包、中途断线和重启板子的情况下都能把整局打完。还没上板实测。详见代码仓库的 docs/protocol.md。

en.title: Networking plan settled: the central board relays, and battles now send out pets
en.body: The three boards use a star topology: the central board holds the single game state and broadcasts a full snapshot every 100 ms; every action from a player board carries a step_id and is resent until it is ACKed. Charging and block timing are measured locally on the player boards, so radio latency doesn't affect them. Each player has 3 pets (fire / water / grass, with type matchups), and both players secretly pick who to send out at the same time. The PC simulator finishes whole games even with 60% packet loss, disconnects mid-game and board restarts. Not yet tested on the boards. Details in docs/protocol.md in the code repository.

author: yihao
title: 进展网站改成中文版，并增加互动内容
body: 新增：可点击的系统架构图、按成员筛选、甘特图任务详情、micro:bit pin 分配图（草案）、战斗玩法原型（可以直接在网页上两个人对打并调参数），以及“写一条进展”生成器。

en.title: Progress site switched to Chinese, with interactive content added
en.body: New: a clickable system architecture diagram, filtering by member, task details in the Gantt chart, a micro:bit pin map (draft), a battle gameplay prototype (two people can battle right in the browser and tune the parameters), and a “Write an update” generator.

author: yihao
title: 代码仓库和固件骨架搭好
body: 基于 nu-microbit-base 建了共享仓库（私有）。写好了 central 和 player 两个固件，以及共享的无线协议 software/lib/protocol.h：消息带序号，关键动作要 ACK，超过 1 s 没收到消息就判定玩家掉线。两个固件都能编译，下一步在两块板上实测。

en.title: Code repository and firmware skeleton set up
en.body: Created a shared (private) repository based on nu-microbit-base. Wrote the central and player firmware plus the shared radio protocol in software/lib/protocol.h: messages carry sequence numbers, key actions need an ACK, and a player is considered disconnected after 1 s without a message. Both firmware builds compile; next step is testing on two boards.

author: all
title: Project proposal 提交
body: 确定 Pocket Rivals：两块玩家板 + 一块中央板，TFT 屏、摇杆、压力传感器、DFPlayer 音效。

en.title: Project proposal submitted
en.body: Settled on Pocket Rivals: two player boards + one central board, with TFT screens, joysticks, pressure sensors and DFPlayer sound effects.
